qa_pair.question: Using the practice log, how many seconds long is the log? Answer with just a whole number.
In the practice log, how many separate times did the elevator current go above 40 amps while the robot was enabled in autonomous mode? Answer with just a whole number.
What is the lowest battery voltage in the practice log, in volts? Answer with just the number.
In the practice log, how many seconds after autonomous began was the first elevator current spike above 40 amps that happened during autonomous? Answer with just a whole number.
In the practice log, at what time in whole seconds from the start of the log was the ERROR message logged? Answer with just a whole number.
What was the highest forward speed (vx) in meters per second the robot reached during autonomous in the practice log? Answer with just a whole number.
For how many seconds was the robot enabled in teleop mode in the practice log? Answer with just a whole number.
In the practice log, how far had the robot driven forward (the x position in meters) 10 seconds after autonomous began? Answer with just a whole number.
In the practice log, what was the arm angle in whole degrees at the moment of the first elevator current spike above 40 amps during autonomous? Answer with just a whole number.
In the practice log, how many times higher was the peak forward speed (vx) in autonomous than in teleop? Answer with just a whole number.
Scan the practice log for trouble. How many errors and warnings does it hold in total? Answer with just a whole number.
